rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show price compressed into an extremely tight range ($48.20–$48.24) with declining volume and no directional momentum — the instrument is effectively frozen with 48 minutes to close. The ATR of ~$0.04 on 5-minute bars is very small relative to spread and slippage risk, and with price sitting mid-range (62.5%) and the 9-EMA essentially at current price, there is no clear mechanical edge in either direction to justify a late-session entry.
